walk_box.selection: One shared tracker; fixed half walk/half box terrain assignment, no skill ID in actor

walk.selection: 6s walking window with low floor penetration among existing LAFAN walk clips; original quality status retained

box.selection: Existing local arm-contact repair, same source terrain; original quality status retained

engineering_choices.reference_contact_input: Next onset within 1.5s; world reference body landmark transformed by CURRENT actual base yaw, with actual scan-footprint gating
engineering_choices.csi_scope: per environment; walk_box shares one actor and critic across fixed walk/box tiles
engineering_choices.critic_reference_frame: reference velocities in reference full body frame; reference contact-body positions in CURRENT actual body-yaw frame, retaining tracking offset
engineering_choices.noise_and_dynamics: Disabled only for initial learning/debug pilot; Table S2 not yet reproduced
engineering_choices.evaluation: Deterministic actions, no noise; separate full-start and curriculum-tail evaluations
engineering_choices.termination: Tracking-error thresholds are engineering choices, not author-disclosed values
